name: Elastic Cloud
description: Monitor Elastic Cloud cluster health and user accounts for monitoring and access review compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Elastic Cloud at https://cloud.elastic.co
2. Go to Organization → API keys
3. Click "Create API key"
4. Select "Organization viewer" role (minimum)
5. Copy the generated key and paste it below

credentialFields.label: API Key
credentialFields.helpText: Elastic Cloud → Organization → API keys → Create API key (Organization viewer minimum).
